summary: A social media post alleged that approximately 7.6 million PLN in cryptocurrency was transferred from a wallet without authorization after the owner's iPhone, which reportedly contained the wallet recovery phrase in iCloud Notes, was returned following forensic examination. The reported cause of the compromise had not been confirmed.
user_mistake: Stored the wallet recovery phrase digitally on the same device associated with the wallet
prevention: Store recovery phrases offline in a secure location separate from internet-connected devices / Avoid keeping the recovery phrase on the same device used to access crypto assets
